_note: Selection of verses from Psalm 102 sung as the First Typical Antiphon at the Liturgy. The base liturgy-fixed.json carries the full 10-verse selection; parishes that sing a short form override the verses array.

variants.label: St. John's Tyler — short form (4 verses)
variants._origin: Parish service practice (St. John of Damascus, Tyler, TX)
value:
Bless the Lord, O my soul; blessed art Thou, O Lord.
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me bless His holy name.
Bless the Lord, O my soul, and forget not all that He hath done for thee,
Bless the Lord, all ye His works, in every place of His dominion.

Bless the Lord, O my soul, and all that is within me,
bless His holy name.
